cohort: The study included women with polyhydramnios from 2015 to 2022 at Rouen University Hospital, excluding those with multiple pregnancies and preterm deliveries before 32 weeks of gestation.
finding: In pregnancies complicated by polyhydramnios, cesarean section was identified as an independent risk factor for PPH, while prophylactic oxytocin administration was an independent protective factor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be an independent risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage in women with polyhydramnios.
